response.overview: Vanya had a lot of fun with his grandparents. He became for them like their own child, wrapped in love and affection. Winter has come, fluffy, crisp snow has fallen. Now you can go sledding and play snowballs. And so the grandfather and Vanyusha decided to make a snow-woman - huge, with a red carrot instead of a nose. And Grandma Vanina still couldn't get enough, because the snow-woman looks so much like her, even if you give it to the museum - it's big, beautiful, it has become a real decoration for the yard. But suddenly the cold frost was replaced by an unexpected warming.
response.title: Пришелец Ванюша
